Good morning. Here is your daily brief for Wednesday 3 June 2026.

Walthamstow: 15°C, overcast, high 19° / low 14°, 100% chance of rain.

GBP/USD 1.347 · GBP/ILS 3.824.

📈 B2B SaaS and go-to-market
- A SaaStr survey found that just 23 percent of founders would choose the same venture capital backers if they could start over, revealing significant dissatisfaction with investor selection despite funding success. <https://www.saastr.com/only-23-of-you-would-pick-the-same-vcs-again/>
- AI agents have surpassed humans in token usage and are burning through budgets faster than anticipated, according to Chris Clark, COO and co-founder of OpenRouter, which operates the largest AI gateway in the world with around 70 model providers. <https://www.saastr.com/agents-just-passed-humans-in-token-usage-and-they-burn-far-more-than-anyone-budgeted-a-deep-dive-with-openrouters-coo/>
- Entrata, a multifamily property management operating system founded in 2003 and based in Lehi Utah, filed for an NYSE IPO on May 28 at 575 million dollars in annual recurring revenue with 23 percent growth, marking the first major PE-backed SaaS company to go public despite a broader trend of slowing growth acceleration. <https://www.saastr.com/entrata-is-first-of-the-next-wave-of-pe-backed-software-ipos-the-catch-almost-none-of-them-are-accelerating/>
- So what for you: As a fractional GTM advisor helping Israeli and UK SaaS founders, watch how the 23 percent VC satisfaction metric reshapes founder confidence in scaling decisions and valuations you're advising on.

🔬 Verified research
- A study published in Nature Water finds that wetland loss across the United States has increased residential flood insurance claim payments by more than ten billion dollars since 1985, underscoring the critical role wetlands play in reducing risk <https://phys.org/news/2026-06-wetlands-loss-residential-payments-billion.html>
- Researchers at the Stokes School of Marine and Environmental Sciences, led by Sean P. Powers, have provided new estimates of greater amberjack abundance in the U.S. South Atlantic and Gulf of America through a multi-year research project <https://phys.org/news/2026-06-greater-amberjack-abundance-south-atlantic.html>
- Scientists at the University of St Andrews discovered that katydids who camouflage themselves as leaves also use their leafy camouflage to amplify mating calls, making themselves more attractive to the opposite sex, according to research published in their recent study <https://phys.org/news/2026-06-leafy-camouflage-reshapes-katydid-songs.html>
- So what for you: With two young kids in Walthamstow, understanding how environmental changes affect property insurance costs could inform your long-term housing and family financial planning in London.

🇮🇱 Israeli politics
- President Donald Trump confirmed on Wednesday that he called Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu "f***ing crazy" during a Monday call, saying he was "perturbed" by constant Lebanon fighting. <https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog-june-03-2026/>
- Netanyahu announced 4.5 billion dollars for Israel's war-battered northern region at a special meeting where few ministers attended and no northern mayors were invited. <https://www.timesofisrael.com/pm-announces-4-5-billion-for-war-battered-north-at-special-meeting-few-ministers-attend/>
- US Secretary of State Rubio told Congress that Netanyahu's pledge to seize 70 percent of Gaza contradicts the Trump administration's plan for the Strip. <https://www.timesofisrael.com/rubio-says-netanyahus-pledge-to-seize-70-of-gaza-contradicts-trump-plan/>
- So what for you: The escalating tension between Trump and Netanyahu suggests further instability in Middle East policy, which could impact Israeli tech company expansion timelines and investor confidence in your GTM advisory clients' fundraising efforts.

📰 Hacker News top 3
- Hacking your PC using your speaker without ever touching it <https://blog.nns.ee/2026/06/03/katana-badusb/>
- Mathematicians issue warning as AI rapidly gains ground <https://www.science.org/content/article/mathematicians-issue-warning-ai-rapidly-gains-ground>
- It is an amazing time for programmers <https://46elks.com/blog/2026/05/29/an-amazing-time-for-programmers>
